info.name: Group Share Machine
info.summary: Puavo-specific: let teachers share files to class groups through the native sharing UI
info.description:
Puavo-specific Nextcloud app. Lets teachers share files with class groups via Nextcloud's standard share dialog, including from the mobile and desktop clients. Teachers are identified by the LDAP-synced role attribute (puavoEduPersonAffiliation = teacher); class groups are recognised by their puavoEduGroupType value (year class, teaching_group).
This app is only useful in deployments that synchronise from a Puavo LDAP instance via user_ldap, with the puavoEdu* schema in place. It is not a general-purpose sharing helper.
info.author: Opinsys Oy
